snippet.title: Version 2.5 Teaser - "To Be Fuel for the Night" | Zenless Zone Zero
snippet.description:
"Maybe this world is still full of conflict and imperfection, but there's always something that binds us together."
"That's why, whenever crisis strikes, someone always steps forward."
"And when all these faint lights... these tiny fireflies gather together, they'll illuminate even the longest night."

—Welcome to New Eridu!—
PS5·iOS·Android·PC·Xbox｜Version 2.4 "On the Precipice of the Abyss" of Zenless Zone Zero, HoYoverse's urban fantasy ARPG, is out now: https://hoyo.link/6SOkFDAL
